title: Mothership Zeta Birth/Birthday Examination Causal Forensics
scope: Audit the relationship among the Lone Wanderer's birth scene, tenth-birthday sequence and Mothership Zeta abduction/examination; determine why the Zetans abduct the player character in shipped code/lore; and test the hypothesis that the Lone Wanderer's birth was arranged by Zetans.

primary_production_trace.developer_comment_semantics: Inside the alien examination timer, the shipped/decompiled script preserves a developer comment stating that this was the location where birthday material would appear; the surrounding timing code was retained for pain SFX.
primary_production_trace.important_lexical_boundary: The comment says birthday, not birth.

birthday_binding_audit.candidate: CG02 / Growing Up Fast / Lone Wanderer tenth birthday
support: CG02 is the explicit protagonist birthday sequence in Fallout 3.
The DLC05 script uses the unqualified phrase birthday stuff during the protagonist's forced examination.
The parallel is player-specific memory imagery inserted into a loss-of-agency medical/torture sequence.
birthday_binding_audit.anti_overclaim: Do not claim that specific CG02 birthday props, NPCs, cake, Pip-Boy or dialogue were definitely rendered during the examination unless the removed object-swap data is independently recovered.

structural_correspondences: reduced or absent ordinary player agency during the sequence
other beings positioned as operators/observers around the protagonist
identity/body state is being examined or established at a threshold

not_checked_in_trigger: prior Zetan designation of the player
abduction_trigger_audit.forensic_result: The executable start condition is proximity-based rather than biography-based.
abduction_trigger_audit.implementation_warning: The script addresses Player because the DLC is implemented for the player character; this alone is not proof that the Zetans canonically regard the Lone Wanderer as cosmically unique.

evidence: Zeta has abducted humans across many centuries rather than only the Lone Wanderer.
Captives are recorded, examined, frozen and/or moved into experimentation pathways.
Alien captive log 19 describes repeated capture and experimentation and claims some humans are transformed into abominations.
The Lone Wanderer is immediately subjected to the same general examination pipeline after proximity-triggered abduction.
why_the_zetans_wanted_the_lone_wanderer.later_exception: The Lone Wanderer becomes exceptional because the captive escapes, organizes resistance and captures the mothership; this exceptional role follows the abduction rather than being established as its cause.

prebirth_causation_hypothesis.claim: Zetans arranged or caused the Lone Wanderer's birth so that the child would later be abducted by Mothership Zeta.
evidence_against_promotion: Catherine's pregnancy and biological maternity are independently supported in the base game.
James's biological paternity is independently supported.
Madison Li witnesses the birth context.
The 2277 DLC abduction trigger is proximity to the Theta beacon rather than a lineage or identity match.
Zeta's established behavior is broad human abduction over centuries.
No reviewed shipped script, dialogue, captive log or quest state binds Zetans to Catherine's pregnancy or the 2258 birth event.
prebirth_causation_hypothesis.logical_boundary: Absence of evidence cannot prove metaphysical impossibility; therefore the claim is not labeled logically impossible, only unsupported in the shipped causal model.

pairs: FAMILY MEDICAL GAZE / ALIEN MEDICAL GAZE
janus_structure.central_threshold: The same player-character life history can be invoked as memory imagery during a later forced body-state threshold without implying that the later operator caused the earlier life event.

cross_registry_links.relation: Sally/Mothership Zeta is already identified as CHILD_AS_BARRIER_BYPASS_GUIDE; v2.7 adds the protagonist childhood-memory/examination layer.
The base-game birth lineage is independently established and constrains exotic alien-origin hypotheses.

anti_overfit_rules: Do not replace birthday with birth in the DLC05 developer comment.
Do not claim exact CG02 assets appeared during the examination unless the removed object-swap implementation is recovered.
Do not infer alien causation of Catherine's pregnancy from a later visual or developmental rhyme.
Do not treat the Player token in a gameplay script as proof of in-world predestination.
Do not claim the Zetans had a unique Project Purity or Lone Wanderer agenda without shipped evidence.
Do not convert a proximity trigger into an identity-selection mechanism.

ru: В коде Mothership Zeta действительно остался след того, что во время болезненного alien examination должна была всплывать birthday-образность героя.
Это прямой production-link к дню рождения, но не доказательство того, что пришельцы создали или организовали рождение героя.
Исполняемый триггер похищения проверяет близость к маяку Theta, а не биографию, родителей или происхождение Lone Wanderer.
Для Zetans герой сначала выглядит как очередной человеческий объект общей программы похищений и экспериментов; исключительным он становится после побега.
Связь рождения и alien examination сильна как структурная рифма; связь birthday и examination сильнее, потому что оставила прямой след в shipped script.
en: Mothership Zeta's shipped script preserves a development trace showing that birthday imagery was planned to appear during the painful alien examination.
That is a direct production link to birthday material, not evidence that the aliens created or arranged the protagonist's birth.
The executable abduction trigger checks proximity to the Theta beacon, not the Lone Wanderer's biography, parents or lineage.
To the Zetans the protagonist initially fits a broad human capture-and-experiment pipeline; exceptional status emerges after escape.
Birth versus examination is a strong structural rhyme, while birthday versus examination is stronger because it leaves a direct shipped-script trace.
